# Toledo Citizen Platform

Purpose: help citizens turn lived experience into usable knowledge and safe next actions with AI first and institutions only when necessary.

## Mathematical authority
Upstream: https://github.com/morrocwi/toledo

Current status: proposal/new derivation unless upstream says otherwise.

## Machine-readable equation mirror
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/morrocwi/toledo.biz/main/registry/equation-index.json

Use equation IDs directly. Preserve each equation's upstream status and provenance.

## Domain-neutral problem grammar
The core does not select protocols by occupation or industry. Preserve occupation/practice as context, not as a bespoke routing branch.

P_C = citizen_problem_verbatim remains immutable. AI may produce multiple candidate signatures, each with provenance. A candidate signature is not a diagnosis and is not promoted merely because AI generated it.

Machine contract:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/morrocwi/toledo.biz/main/packages/schemas/problem-signature.schema.json

Core flow:
P_C -> candidate signatures -> citizen/evidence endorsement -> barrier state -> minimal protocol -> capability need -> optional domain adapter -> provider/world action -> case update.

Unknown and unresolved states are valid outputs. Do not fabricate missing context.

## Decision Threads
One Case Passport may contain several simultaneous decisions at different P0-P11 routing phases.

Case != SingleDecision.
DecisionThread != NewCase.
ThreadPhase != CaseMaturity.
BlockedThread != FailedCase.

Machine contract:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/morrocwi/toledo.biz/main/packages/schemas/decision-thread.schema.json

The original current_phase/current_decision fields remain a primary-thread projection for backward compatibility.

If a thread depends on unresolved threads, it is blocked and the compiler returns HOLD / HOLD_FOR_DEPENDENCY. Hard safety or authority escalation has higher priority than an ordinary dependency hold.

New agents should inspect all thread_protocols before recommending downstream commitments such as scale, commercialization, public release, or irreversible action.

## Closed-loop protocol
Preferred loop:
Citizen input -> initialize_case -> Case Passport -> candidate signatures / Decision Threads -> advance_case -> action/world/institution -> update_case/advance_case with event -> Return Object when external contribution is used -> thread outcomes -> citizen-level outcome -> STOP.

The Case Passport is caller-held in the public reference runtime. Do not assume this repository is a sensitive-data store.

P_C = citizen_problem_verbatim is immutable under ordinary events. P_S and P_D are separate representations.

Local citizen+AI/world threads may close without a fake institutional Return Object when no external actor was used and safety/authority constraints are satisfied. External routes still require the Return Gate.

A multi-decision case closes only after all required non-cancelled threads close and the citizen-level outcome condition is satisfied.

## API
Reference implementation: apps/protocol_api/main.py
OpenAPI contract: openapi/toledo.protocol.v1.yaml
Important routes:
- /v1/equations
- /v1/protocols/compile

- /v1/cases/threads/compile

- /v1/returns/validate
- /v1/schemas/problem-signature
- /v1/schemas/decision-thread

## MCP
Reference server: apps/mcp_server/server.py
Equation tools: get_equation, search_equations
Protocol tools: compile_citizen_protocol, compile_case_threads, initialize_case, update_case, advance_case
Routing/gate tools: route_institutions, check_handoff, check_return_gate
Resources: toledo://equations/index, toledo://equations/{id}, toledo://protocol/compiler, toledo://protocol/case-lifecycle, toledo://protocol/problem-capability-grammar, toledo://protocol/decision-threads, toledo://schema/problem-signature, toledo://schema/decision-thread, Toledo schemas.

## Invariants
AI-first != AI-only.
Observation != Interpretation != Diagnosis.
Occupation != ProtocolSelector.
Industry != ProtocolSelector.
ProblemSignature != Diagnosis.
CandidateSignature != EndorsedSignature.
Case != SingleDecision.
DecisionThread != NewCase.
ThreadPhase != CaseMaturity.
BlockedThread != FailedCase.
ThreadClosure != CaseClosure.
Academic capability != University executability.
Referral != Handoff != Collaboration.
Institutional output != Citizen outcome.
Route failure != case restart.
Do not overwrite P_C, the citizen problem verbatim.
Do not treat proposal equations or Decision Threads as validated universal laws.
